name: Dickson Furniture Manufacturers
old_description: Since 1976, Dickson Furniture Manufacturers has been creating best-in-class furniture solutions for the hospitality, student housing, multi-unit housing, and government markets. Proudly made in the USA, our furniture combines design-driven aesthetics, exceptional durability, and dependable lead times — all backed by our Texas-based manufacturing and local supply chain.
about:
Dickson Furniture Manufacturers was founded by Jim Dickson in 1976 in Houston, Texas. The privately owned company began with a principle of creating exceptional value through uncompromising quality, and has since grown into a vertically integrated contract furniture manufacturer serving commercial markets nationwide.

Operating from a 500,000-square-foot facility in Houston, Dickson produces casegoods, upholstered seating, and structured seating in-house. The plant runs automated TFL and HPL lines, CNC beam saws, routers, edge banders, and dedicated upholstery equipment including CNC fabric and foam cutters. Monthly output exceeds 50,000 casegoods and 5,000 upholstered pieces, with additional capacity for mattress production and powder-coated metal frames. The company also handles delivery and installation.

Dickson serves the hospitality, student housing, multi-unit housing, government, and military sectors. It is a preferred or approved vendor for more than a dozen national hotel brands and has furnished over 10,000 properties across the United States and its territories, including select-service and upper select-service hotels, student communities, and public-sector housing.

The company emphasizes its domestic supply chain, sourcing most materials from suppliers within two hours of the Houston plant to ensure consistent quality, predictable lead times, and reduced transportation impact. Dickson’s in-house laminate layup provides greater finish flexibility, while its vertically integrated model allows full control over quality, timelines, and innovation. The firm describes itself as built to last, not to sell, with continual reinvestment in manufacturing technology such as a recent $10 million TFL line.

name: Dimatic Die & Tool Co
old_description: Dimatic Die & Tool Company has excelled in manufacturing since 1961, and currently employs approximately 60 people at its Omaha plant of over 67,000 square feet.  Robert Drvol and Guenter Sobeck founded Dimatic in South Omaha as a two-person tool and die shop in 1961.   They had previously worked together for years as toolmakers.  At the start, Robert and Guenter gathered enough money to purchase two machines and found a building to start their company on 13th Street, across from Sokol Auditorium.  In 1968, Dimatic expanded into the production stamping and production machining areas, and soon began the production molding of plastic resins.  Strong steady growth has served Dimatic well over the years.  In 1978, Dimatic moved to their current facility located at 9520 North 48th Street in Omaha.  Since that time, they have expanded their facilities to the current structure.  An emphasis on customer service and building tools and parts the right way has resulted in a stable and long-standing base of customers.
about:
Dimatic Die & Tool Co. was founded in 1961 in South Omaha, Nebraska, by toolmakers Robert Drvol and Guenter Sobeck. The two-person shop started on 13th Street across from Sokol Auditorium with two machines. In 1978 the company moved to its current 67,000-square-foot facility at 9520 North 48th Street in Omaha.

Today the privately held company employs about 60 people and operates as a single-source manufacturer offering tool and die design, injection molding on 55- to 880-ton presses, production stamping up to 165 tons, CNC machining (including turning centers and machining centers), EDM and wire EDM, and assembly with automated painting. The shop produces turned parts from 1/4 to 8 inches in diameter, milled parts up to 20 by 20 inches, and runs volumes from one to 100,000 pieces. It also manufactures pressed and solid steel pulleys ranging from 2.5 to 16 inches.

Dimatic serves a mix of Fortune 500 corporations, mid-size manufacturers, distributors, and small businesses across the United States and internationally. Typical components include enclosures, cases, housings, brackets, bearing retainers, electrical parts, and pulleys for industrial and commercial equipment.

The company emphasizes single-source responsibility—design, tooling, production, warehousing, and distribution under one roof—and cites its ISO-based quality system, an average toolmaker tenure of more than 25 years, and a central U.S. location near I-680 and Eppley Airfield as key differentiators.

name: Discovery Semiconductors Inc
old_description: Discovery Semiconductors, Inc. is an industry leader in manufacturing ultrafast, high optical power handling InGaAs photodetectors, RF over fiber optical receivers, balanced optical receivers, extended wavelength photodetectors, and several custom products for applications ranging from analog RF links to ultrafast digital communications. Discovery began operations in 1993 and has grown into a global enterprise by leading the market with high-technology products for 10, 25, 40, and 100 Gb applications. Discovery's instrumentation and systems include the Lab Buddy and Optical Coherent Receiver System. Since 1998, Discovery Semiconductors maintains a world class clean room facility for manufacturing high reliability products for telecom, datacom, avionics and aerospace applications.
about:
Discovery Semiconductors operates from Ewing Township, New Jersey. The company began operations in 1993 and has maintained a clean room facility since 1998 for high-reliability manufacturing. No ownership tags or founders are disclosed in the source material.

The company manufactures ultrafast, high-optical-power-handling InGaAs photodetectors, RF-over-fiber optical receivers, balanced optical receivers, extended-wavelength photodetectors, and custom photonic products. Its instrumentation line includes the Lab Buddy and Optical Coherent Receiver System. Production takes place in a dedicated clean room, though facility size and headcount are not specified.

Products serve telecommunications, data communications, avionics, aerospace, and space missions (LEO, GEO, lunar, and Mars). Applications include analog RF links, ultrafast digital communications, sensing, optical communications, RF photonics, LIDAR, and laser interferometry. A noted example is the space-qualified InGaAs quad photodiode plus transimpedance amplifier receiver.

Discovery emphasizes high-reliability manufacturing in its clean room and has been recognized as a 2020 and 2021 Military & Aerospace Electronics Innovators Award honoree. The company positions itself as a leader in high-optical-power-handling and ultrafast InGaAs devices.

name: Dogwood Solar
old_description: Dogwood Solar has helped numerous home and business owners in Missouri go solar through the installation of solar panels, battery backup systems and more. Learn more about the solar options right for you.
about:
Dogwood Solar is based in Columbia, Missouri, and has been serving the state since 2010. The company is owned and operated by Dan Shifley, who holds NABCEP certification and a Master Electrician license in Columbia. Shifley founded the business with a mission to promote solar energy alternatives and provide sustainable options to homeowners and business owners.

The firm specializes in the design and installation of solar photovoltaic systems and battery backup storage for residential and commercial properties. Services include site analysis, energy needs assessment, system design, permitting, and installation performed by a licensed electrical team. Dogwood Solar provides a 10-year workmanship warranty in addition to manufacturer warranties on equipment.

Customers range from homeowners in Boone County and surrounding areas to businesses and non-profit organizations across Missouri. The company has completed projects for repeat clients and participates in community events such as the Columbia Earth Day Festival and the Green Expo.

Shifley emphasizes a no-pressure, educational approach, walking clients through options without overselling. The team stresses respect for property, thorough cleanup, and long-term utility savings as core differentiators.

It cites premium materials, innovative design, and skilled craftsmanship as differentiators, along with a paint system designed for durability against corrosion and abrasion.

about:
Dorr Mill Store has been based in Guild, New Hampshire since its founding in 1976. The company runs a retail operation focused on yarn, fabric, and rug-hooking supplies, serving customers both in-store and online.

The store carries a wide range of materials for traditional and contemporary fiber crafts, including worsted wools, hand-dyed fabrics, foundation cloth, rug-binding supplies, punch-needle kits, and roving for needle felting. Inventory is organized by product type and sold by the yard, in bundles, or as pre-assembled kits. The business also maintains a classes page advertising local workshops and events.

Customers include individual crafters, rug-hooking enthusiasts, needle-felting artists, and punch-needle hobbyists. The shop supplies materials for projects ranging from hooked rugs and wool appliqué to felted ornaments and camp blankets. No industrial or wholesale accounts are mentioned in the available information.

The company emphasizes personal assistance, with staff available by phone or email during business hours, and promotes monthly specials and a loyalty discount on yarns. A gift-card program is offered for gift-giving within the fiber-arts community.

name: Dovetail Custom Wood & Metal
old_description: Since 2014, Dovetail has grown into one of the largest architectural fabricators in the Southwest. Our team combines deep technical expertise with hands-on craftsmanship, creating work that bridges precision and creativity.
about:
Dovetail Custom Wood & Metal was founded in 2014 in Del Valle, Texas, by Isaac Alexander, whose lifelong passion for craftsmanship began on a farm near Austin. The company takes its name from the dovetail joint, a hallmark of strength that still appears on every cabinet drawer box it produces.

The firm operates a 110,000‑square‑foot facility with roughly 170 employees, offering engineering and drafting (Microvellum, Cabinet Vision, Revit, AutoCAD), fabrication in wood, metal, and stone, a finishing department equipped with a mixology lab and three spray booths, and full installation services managed by OSHA‑certified superintendents. Notable projects include the Travis Tower and the Ismaili Centre.

Dovetail serves commercial construction, architectural millwork, and institutional clients, working with general contractors, design teams, and owners on complex architectural interiors and exteriors.

The company says its differentiation lies in housing wood, metal, and stone fabrication under one roof, a culture of collaboration and innovation, and a belief that seemingly unachievable designs can be crafted with excellence.

name: Dream Builders Wood
old_description: Are you looking for custom kitchen cabinets? Dream Builders Wood brings beautiful craftsmanship, excellent materials, and attention to detail to every job. Eric’s custom cabinetry is unmatched, making it an easy choice.
about:
Dream Builders Wood operates from Honolulu, Hawaii. The business traces its roots to 1996 when founder Eric Blanco launched his first workshop, Tony Blanco Wood Designs, in the Dominican Republic. After relocating to the United States in 2001, Blanco re-established the company as Dream Builders Wood on Oahu in 2016. The firm is owner-operated by Blanco, who serves as chief carpenter.

The shop provides completely custom woodworking services, including kitchen and bathroom cabinetry, custom furniture, doors, frames, trim, and small decorative items. All pieces are built to order in the company's Honolulu workshop, with Blanco overseeing each project from design through finishing.

Dream Builders Wood serves residential and commercial clients across Hawaii, delivering cabinets for home kitchens and business offices, as well as furniture and architectural millwork for individual homeowners and designers. The company emphasizes work for the local "Ohanas" community.

Blanco's approach is shaped by his early training in the Dominican Republic and a personal philosophy of creating exclusive, lasting designs. He cites the inspiration of the racehorse Secretariat as a turning point that led to the 2016 reopening, and the company highlights its commitment to exceeding expectations with fine-finish furniture that retains value across generations.

about:
Dufrane Technologies was founded in 1876 in Winsted, Connecticut, and remains a family-owned business operating as part of the Dufrane family of companies. The company began as a manufacturer of custom electromagnetic components and has expanded over more than a century to include precision machining services.

Today the company produces custom transformers, custom coils and windings, and precision machined parts from its 80,000-square-foot facility. Its manufacturing capabilities include CNC milling and turning with work envelopes up to 20 by 20 inches, 5-axis machining centers, and automatic pallet changers for continuous production. The shop also offers reverse engineering, build-to-print manufacturing, and design-build services for electromagnetic and mechanical components.

Dufrane serves industrial and military customers, supplying high-integrity transformers and coils for applications that require rigorous electrical conditioning. Its client base includes defense contractors and original equipment manufacturers seeking contract manufacturing for both electromagnetic and purely mechanical parts.

The company emphasizes its combined 150-plus years of experience, in-house machining capacity, and value-added engineering as key differentiators. It was built to provide a single source for custom coil winding, transformer design, and precision machining, reducing lead times and ensuring quality control across the entire production process.

old_description: As one of the most reputed and experienced corrugated box suppliers in the St. Louis and Columbia, MO region, Duro-Flex offers a variety of standard and customized packaging solutions for a variety of industries. about:
Duro-Flex, a family-owned corrugated packaging manufacturer, was founded in 1956 in High Hill, Missouri. For over 70 years the company has served businesses across the Midwest from its facility along Interstate 70, growing into a regional supplier with nationwide reach.

The company produces single-, double-, and triple-wall corrugated boxes, custom foam inserts, die-cut packaging, printed boxes, industrial-grade pallet boxes, collapsible bulk shippers, hazardous-waste containers, corrugated pallets, and specialty wood crates. Its capabilities include custom corrugated design, foam fabrication, die cutting, multi-color printing, and full package assembly with inner partitions and dividers.

Duro-Flex serves the aerospace, construction, food and beverage, e-commerce, medical, and general industrial sectors. Customers range from local Missouri manufacturers to national distributors who rely on the company for both standard and custom packaging solutions.

The company cites its membership in the Association of Independent Corrugated Converters (AICC), complete packaging assembly services, local delivery throughout Missouri and the Midwest, and outsourced shipping nationwide as key differentiators. It emphasizes a hands-on, customer-service approach built on decades of family ownership.
